name: create_memory
description: Creates a new named memory for a game. Fails if a memory with the same slug already exists — use update_memory to modify an existing one. Use this to record world lore, NPC decisions, plot developments, or anything the DM should remember across sessions.

game.description: The slug of the game this memory belongs to.

slug.description: A unique, URL-safe identifier for this memory within the game (e.g., 'mayor-betrayal').

name.description: A short descriptive label for the memory (e.g., 'Mayor Thornwick betrayed the party').
